_doc: Task 5.5 machine-readable MVP stack decision for BuildReasonSeg. Design only: nothing was downloaded, installed or trained. Every field is annotated with an evidence label: VERIFIED (read first-hand from an official source: model config, API, LICENSE file, publisher page, vendor documentation), PLATFORM_FIELD (official platform field such as an HF API license tag or GitHub API license.spdx_id), MEASURED (read from the local target machine), ESTIMATE (author arithmetic or judgement, NOT a measurement), UNVERIFIED (no reachable source).

primary_stack.name: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct + SAM 2.1 hiera-large, LISA-style [SEG], BF16 LoRA r=16

tokens.note: The [REF] TOKEN is prior art (SegLLM arXiv 2410.18923; PSALM ECCV 2024). Only the geometric use of the predicted reference is claimed.

fallback_stack.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct + SAM 2.1 hiera-base-plus, identical recipe

baseline_only_stacks.role: isolates how much of the performance comes from spatial reasoning

image_policy.first_resolution: 512x512 native (the BuildSpatialReason tile size), no upscaling
image_policy.derivation: patch_size 16 x merge_size 2 = 32x32 px per token; 512/32 = 16 => 16x16 = 256 tokens (VERIFIED from config)
image_policy.warning: Qwen3-VL's released preprocessor_config.json contains no min_pixels/max_pixels keys, so Qwen2.5-VL's defaults (min_pixels 3136, max_pixels 12845056) must not be inherited

external_datasets.warmup_recommendation: no external dataset before BuildSpatialReason; warm-up is unnecessary and most candidate licences are unresolved

decisive_finding.question: Is there any public remote-sensing reasoning-segmentation dataset combining instance-level BUILDING masks with multi-hop spatial instructions?
decisive_finding.evidence: no public dataset was verified to combine all three; BRIGHT has ~291k building instance polygons but no language; LaSeRS/DRSeg have instance masks but unverified building coverage; EarthReason has reasoning but region masks; RISBench/RRSIS-D have no building class and only explicit referring

closest_adjacent_source_checked.title: From Pixels to Semantics: Can a Single Instruction-Tuned VLM Unify Geospatial Building Analysis?
closest_adjacent_source_checked.effect_on_answer: none — it is a model/adaptation study whose dataset spans segmentation, detection, VQA and captioning, not spatial relations

geometry_verifiable_spatial_reasoning_da.note: no surveyed work supervises a stated spatial relation in a form re-checkable geometrically from the annotation

ref_style_reference_token.note: SegLLM (arXiv 2410.18923) uses [REF]+[SEG] with supervised reference mask; PSALM (ECCV 2024) also uses a [REF] token

seg_target_token.note: LISA, LISA++, GSVA, PixelLM, GLaMM, PSALM, Sa2VA, SegLLM, SAMTok

reference_mask_to_geometry_or_spatial_pr.note: SegLLM re-injects a mask-derived bounding-box positional embedding plus a masked-object CLIP embedding into the LLM

explicit_spatial_relation_encoder.note: no dedicated relation encoder over predicted region geometry found

semantic_spatial_visual_fusion.note: crowded; every pixel-level MLLM fuses language and visual features

spatial_consistency_loss.note: spatial losses exist (SegEarth-R2 attention-space supervision; Think2Seg-RS mask-IoU GRPO reward) but no relation-contradiction loss found

multi_hop_spatial_reasoning_supervision.note: SegLLM multi-round chains; TerraScope L2-Spatial; neither is a single chained instruction with a geometric check

building_or_remote_sensing_specializatio.note: ISPRS Annals XI-2-2026 (July 2026) instruction-tunes PaliGemma 2 for geospatial building analysis; BRIGHT has building polygons; several RS reasoning methods exist

retain: geometry-verifiable relation supervision (evidenced absence, stated as such)
explicit Spatial Relation Encoder over self-predicted region geometry (lead contribution)
Spatial Consistency Loss on spatial relations
instance-level building + reference-anchored + multi-hop instruction setting
narrow: [REF] + [SEG] -> the claim becomes the GEOMETRIC use of the predicted reference, not the token
reframe: semantic-spatial-visual fusion -> architectural detail / ablation, not a headline claim
building specialisation -> problem setting, not a contribution
drop: any first/novel claim about [SEG], [REF], pixel-level MLLM segmentation, or instruction-tuning for buildings
any claim that the Task 5B hidden-eligibility correction is a scientific contribution
any claim that a Chinese-instruction setting is itself novel
